notes: 1.45.15: Batch A+B cua yeu cau 'PHF AI phu toan he sinh thai PHF HR' - gop 1 ban vi 2 batch cung cham lib/ai-sandbox.js (vong lap tool-calling) va lib/ai-tool-registry.js (registry), tach thanh 2 commit se de lai 1 commit trung gian khong chay duoc. Batch A: mo PHF AI tu chi Admin sang ca 3 role (admin/manager/learner) tai api/ai/chat.js + server.js (requireSession(['admin','manager','learner'])), moi tool tu derive quyen tu session (khong hard-code theo ten role), khong sua permission business hien huu. Tool doc moi: lib/ai-training-tools.js (tien do hoc + tong quan chuong trinh Training Hub - nguon la file tinh assets/data/phf-lessons-new-sales.js vi chua co bang DB rieng, khong doc noi dung HTML tung bai), lib/ai-classroom-tools.js (tim lop + tien do hoc Classroom, tai su dung listClasses/getLearning), 3 tool Checklist con thieu (phieu thang/viec can xu ly/thong bao CUA CHINH actor), search_knl_people. Crosswalk employeeCode (Checklist) -> employeeId (Training Hub) di qua getChecklistReportAccess() da scope san, KHONG doc user_accounts. Batch B: dieu huong thong minh - tool moi navigate_to voi enum whitelist co dinh NAV_TARGETS (lib/ai-tool-registry.js), model CHI duoc chon 1 trong 5 khoa (hub_home/training_hub/classroom/checklist/knl), KHONG tu sinh URL. Backend chi validate target nam trong whitelist; frontend (phf-ai-engine.js#resolveNavTarget) tu resolve khoa -> path that theo role ROI doi chieu voi window.PHF_ROUTE_REGISTRY that (route ton tai + dung quyen role) truoc khi hien nut - neu khong khop thi AN nut, khong dua nguoi dung toi route cam. Response contract them truong 'actions' o cap cao nhat (tuong thich nguoc, optional, KHONG doi result.type/data/evidence). Da dang ky day du vao lib/ai-tool-registry.js (16 tool + navigate_to) + buildStructuredResult/buildAction, cap nhat SYSTEM_PROMPT (pham vi moi + phan biet 'khong co du lieu' vs 'chua ho tro' + huong dan dung navigate_to), mo floating widget cho 3 role. Tien the nay cung tu sua 1 thieu sot: ban 1.45.14 da doi noi dung phf-ai-sandbox.css (header cam batch D) nhung QUEN bump ?v= - da bump bu trong ban nay. Da chay npm run check/git diff --check/node --check truoc khi bump. Bump ?v= cho phf-ai-sandbox.css, phf-ai-engine.js, phf-ai-floating.js (3 asset browser thuc su doi noi dung) sang 1.45.15_ai_coverage_nav_batch_ab; cac file lib/*.js la server-side, khong qua browser cache-busting.
